Definition: from G1909 and G1125; to inscribe (physically or mentally):--inscription, write in (over, thereon).
BiblicalUsage: Epigrapho means to write upon, to inscribe. Paul finds an altar with the inscription, To the unknown God; and God promises, I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts; and the names of the twelve tribes are written on the twelve gates of the New Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: God writes where it matters: not on stone that breaks, but on hearts that live. I hold that the altar to the unknown God shows how hungry men are for the God who writes there, and Paul's sermon is the answer to that hunger.
